questions.answer: No approval is derived from them. Original310 independently has23 printed rows including footer, with no text in the80px edge strips. questions.answer: Yes. It reuses the two supplied live receipts and latest179 comment830251c5-4c6f-48af-9bae-6e3a22118c80 within the same invocation, with finish=review and Grill=self. questions.answer: I changed no author/product file, ran no producer, repaired no candidate and promoted nothing.
